data.body:
[P2] Extend reentrancy protection to change hooks

A plugin that protects its hooks with a `Lock` and reads an already-terminal `Callback.result()` inside `on_operation_change` can now deadlock. This guard is false during change dispatch, so an unclaimed callback end hook runs synchronously inside the change hook and tries to acquire the same lock. If another thread owns the end hook, the read instead waits while that owner needs the held lock. Either case prevents invocation shutdown from completing. Previously, checkpoint processing delivered end hooks before the change hook, and result reads dispatched nothing. Track dispatch depth for all plugin hooks and make their result reads inspection-only; add a regression test covering change-hook reads with a shared lock.
